text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан and I head to the cafeteria
to get
some food.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'm going to go order.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I've been wanting a thick-cut steak since
morning.
I won't accept anything else.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: One mega-thick steak, please!
text_block_list.name: Brian and Amazon

text_block_list.text:
Fancy seein' you here. And ordering the
same
thing, no less.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, girls. There's only one left.
text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady

text_block_list.text: ...I ordered first. Give it here, please.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?! We
ordered at the
same time!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I've been wanting steak all day, so
there's no way
I'm giving up.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I've been talking about steak all day! I
won't let
you have it!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We'll settle this with a
one-on-one—winner takes
the steak!
How's that sound?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Tch... Fine.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
As for what kind of competition...You!
Brian's
trainer. You decide, to keep
things fair.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list:
How about we forget the competition and just
eat something else?

Speed battle! Let's see who can eat a habanero
bun the fastest!

Stamina battle! Let's see who can dance the
longest!

Power battle! Let's have a ruthless game of milk
caps!

text_block_list.text:
Hey! I told you I was in the mood for
thick-cut
meat. Are you even listening?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
No way. I need something I can really
sink my
teeth into.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
What about this fried pork steak? Thick
enough?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Fried pork steak... doesn't sound bad,
actually.
Maybe I'll go with that.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
All right! The time has come for the fried
pork
steak showdown!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Why? I gave up on the regular steak, so
you can
just have it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, right! There's no reason to
battle
anymore!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I got into battle mode for nothin',
then!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Sounds interesting! You got any
complaints,
Brian?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Not at all. Let's do it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Within these buns lies an
excruciatingly
spicy habanero pepper!
Just a whiff of one of
these beauties is
enough to set off your internal
fire
alarm!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'll just finish it before I have time to
taste it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Chomp, chomp. Now, that is... S-SPICY!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I just have to leave my taste buds in the
dust!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
What the—that's so fast! How can you
chew so
fast?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
No thinking, no feeling! Just chew it all
up and
gulp it down!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Da shtake ij mine. Shorry.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
You wanted to win so bad you injured
your own
throat?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're really somethin'! The
mega-thick
steak belongs to you!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'll just finish it before I have time to
taste it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Chomp chomp chomp... Augh!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...That's hot! Am I not eating fast
enough?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Oho, looks like you're slowin' down!
Time to finish
you off!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
It feels like my tongue is on fire! Ugh... I
can't
take any more...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh! Da shteak ij mine!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Tch... At least wait for your mouth to
cool off
before you eat it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Ahhh. Instead of crushin' our opponents,
we have
to battle ourselves!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list:
This is going to kick up some dust, so let's move
somewhere else.

text_block_list.text:
This looks like a good spot! All right, on
your
signal!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Tch... You sure picked an annoying way
to settle
this.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Okay, Brian! Let's dance till we drop!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
And so begins the fierce battle for the
steak!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Had enough yet? You can give up
anytime!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Don't be stupid. I'm just getting warmed
up!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Huh, you serious?! Now that's heart!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Ahh, I can't go on! I can't even lift a
finger...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Done already? Looks like the steak is
mine.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Tch... Wh-what?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
My body isn't doing what I'm telling it
to!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, that was close for me too, but a
win's a
win!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Huff... Damn... Take it, then.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Just subdue your opponent by force,
huh? Very
good. Perfect for a steak
prize.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Hmph. That steak is mine!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
All right, let's get this started already.
Standard
rules, you know the drill.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Yaaah!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: You managed to flip two. Not bad... but!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I'll finish this in one shot!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Th-they all went flyin'! It was like an
eruption!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: It's pointless to continue. Victory is mine.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that was quite the showing!
You've proven
yourself worthy of the
mega-thick steak!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Nice effort, but nothing budged. Put
more power
into it!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Tch... This isn't going well...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан loses the dance battle and
her
chance to eat the steak.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Basking in the afterglow of victory,
Нарита Брайан
enjoys her mega-thick steak!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан can't seem to flip any milk
caps, no
matter how many times she
tries. Victory escapes
her grasp,
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Having achieved total victory, Narita
Brian
thoroughly enjoys her mega-thick
steak!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The battle is lost, and so is Нарита Брайан's
chance
to eat steak today...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан digs into the steak despite
her
injuries.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан looks totally satisfied as she
eats her
pork steak.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
